description: RFC 0008 stage 5 mutation battery: the guarantee ladder order and single normative table, the policy source declaration at every routing branch (including the forced bounded backend), the guarantee-floor enforcement and its precedence ordering, the field 8 request gate and closed enum, the field 10/11 vocabulary split, the cache-hit-vs-certified labeling, the declared (non-inferred) wire source, and the protocol-version gate. Every mutation must turn its suite red; 0 equivalent.

expected.rationale: Each mutation weakens the ladder, relabels a source, skips/inverts the floor or one of its precedence checks, crosses the guarantee-level field vocabulary, widens the request gate, or downgrades the protocol handshake. The structural provenance oracle, the ladder table test, and the end-to-end guarantee wire suite each observe the change directly.

a policy source (chart) wrongly earns certified_bound

    case DecisionSource::RiverLp:
mutations.replace:

      return Guarantee::CertifiedBound;
    case DecisionSource::PostflopHeuristic:
    case DecisionSource::RiverLp:
